title: Discs Redistributed
description: Distributes all the vanilla discs into every vanilla structure's loot tables, making them more available!!
body:
A simple data pack that implements all the music discs into the loot tables of vanilla structures! 

This makes it so the discs, specifically the C418 ones, are accessible in ways closer in line to modern discs implementation rather than most of them being hidden behind an obscure creeper feature. I've tried to make each disc fit its new enviroment, which can be emphasised by using the optional resource pack included! The same file can be used as a data pack AND resource pack, so just install the file twice and have 1 in your worlds datapack folder and the other in youre resource packs!

<details>
<summary>Disc locations</summary>

- Chirp - Ruined portals
- Blocks - Village houses
- 13 - Mineshafts
- Far - Jungle temples
- Cat - Monster dungeons
- Ward - Desert temples
- Otherside - Stronghold libraries
- Wait - Shipwrecks
- Mellohi - Buried Treasure
- Mall - End Cities
- Stal - Pillager Outposts
- Strad - Igloos
- 11 - Underwater ruins
- Tears - Nether fortress
- Lava Chicken - Woodland Mansions

Pigstep, 5, Relic, Precipice and Creator have not been edited, as i was happy with their implementation!

</details>

Future plans: This was my first data pack project and I may come back to expand this projects scope, by making discs also available through new methods (e.g. pigstep through killing a piglin brute)
